## Earnie 2.6.0

Official **MINOR** after **2.5.3**. Focus: Home Assistant coupling (EHAL Pattern B), add-on channels, Shadow Mode S1 recorder, and quality hardening through the `2.6.0-alpha.*` community line.

### Highlights

- **HA / EHAL-Com (2.6.a–i, n)** — HouseSim bench, suggest-and-confirm bindings, Pattern B on `house_profiles`, energy counters, entity-picker UX, HA credentials in `.env`, battery controllability / Huawei force services
- **Add-on & install (2.6.j–m)** — x86-64-v2 preflight, dual release channels (`earnie` / `earnie_prerelease`), network checks, startup / runtime monitoring
- **Shadow Mode S1 (2.6.o)** — Prod feed recorder for later Shadow S2+S3 (**2.7.f**)
- **Absent / holiday (2.6.p)** — EHAL absent mode on all backends
- **Ops & Monitor** — Silent/Loud on Optimierer-Dienst, Sankey under Chart 1, green-zone OLS prices, EV open-cycle latch, BOM-safe debug dumps, many live-verified bugfixes
- **Quality (2.6.r)** — coverage ~80%+, KPI mega-file splits, docs sync; community alphas `2.6.0-alpha.1` … `2.6.0-alpha.12`

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0`
- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:latest`
- Also `:next` after you approve **promote**

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

Deploy: [docs/einrichtung/container.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/einrichtung/container.md)

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml up -d
```

(Same pattern for `loxberry_productive.yml` / `proxmox_productive.yml`.)

HA add-on: update official **Earnie** to **2.6.0** from `https://github.com/JochenTCC/ha-addon-earnie` after promote.
